notes.title: PC Update - Game is available for PC now!
notes.content:
PC Game update has been published. Now this game will work on PC and VR both. 

To run the game in VR mode, Make sure that the VR is connected and SteamVR or Oculus is working. 

To run the game on PC, Simply run the game from Steam :)

Hope that you would enjoy the game!
Thanks
CHVR Team
